title: Validate packaged Spec Builder sample assets
description: Verify that packaged sample JSON and markdown files are realistic, internally consistent, and aligned with the current registry contracts.
preconditions: The packaged source_assets bundle has been synced with the current Spec Builder registry.
Each sample file exists under source_assets/samples/json or source_assets/samples/markdown.

steps.action: Open each packaged sample JSON file and confirm required fields are populated with non-placeholder values.
steps.expected_result: Every JSON sample contains a stable id, correct type, and realistic supporting metadata.

steps.action: Open each packaged sample markdown file and confirm it includes representative sections expected by its artifact skill.
steps.expected_result: Markdown samples are readable, artifact-specific, and aligned with their companion JSON metadata.

steps.action: Cross-check referenced ids and document paths across roadmap, epic, story, test case, and spec samples.
steps.expected_result: Linked ids and markdown paths are internally consistent and use current Spec Builder path conventions.

postconditions: Packaged samples can be used as trustworthy defaults or examples for maintainers and users.
